navaid.name: NOAAS Oscar Elton Sette
navaid.description: NOAA Ship Oscar Elton Sette is a multipurpose oceanographic research vessel operating throughout the central and western Pacific Ocean, doing fisheries assessments, physical and chemical oceanography research, marine mammal and marine debris surveys.
